text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Goodness... To think you could harvest so many. As expected of you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's put this one... next to the alarm clock.
And this one... next to the pillow.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let us dust it off every day to keep it clean.
Just as the fire in my heart continues to burn.
